name: field_bunds_traced
note: Ferdin (23 Oct 2026): the Patto and Taleigao fields are bunded, like the khazan in the CZMP mask, and so are the St Inez / Merces fields east of 73.848 E. The bunds themselves are not mapped, so the fields are traced from data (tools/trace_field_bunds.py, see trace): open, unbuilt, low land inside the three named areas (Cowork's two test boxes, docs/STEP_PROMPT_model_p3_accuracy.md, and the St Inez / Merces area east of 73.848 E to the St Inez segment's edge, 73.875 E), from Sentinel-2 cloudless 2016 (smooth, green surface), the OSM + Microsoft building footprints (under 10% of the cell roofed) and OSM farmland. Built-up low land, such as Patto Plaza and the bus-stand blocks, is left out: a field bund does not protect it. Inside the traced fields, every in-scope cell that is unclassified land, CRZ-III or a waterbody, outside the khazan mask, with ground at or below spring high water (+1.0 m), joins the khazan land behind the bunds: the same crest (bundCrestM, 1.5 m, 1.0-2.0 m placeholder) and the same bund-failure toggle. Extent: reasoned_extrapolation (traced at the 55 m grid, not surveyed); crest: placeholder_needs_calibration.

properties.source: tools/trace_field_bunds.py: open, unbuilt, low land inside the Patto, Taleigao and St Inez / Merces areas (fieldBunds.boxes), as connected groups of grid cells. Field cell: unclassified, CRZ-III or waterbody, outside the khazan mask, more than 3 cells from the open sea and east of 73.815 E (the Miramar beach strip), ground at or below the bund crest (1.5 m), roof footprint under 10% of the cell (OSM + Microsoft), and in Sentinel-2 cloudless 2016 a smooth (brightness std <= 10 of 255), green (green >= red) and not bright (mean <= 100) surface, or OSM landuse=farmland/paddy. Groups of at least 3 cells. Rings are read even-odd (holes are unbuilt patches that fail the rule). The model bunds only the cells at or below spring high water.

Groups of at least 3 cells. Rings are read even-odd (holes are unbuilt patches that fail the rule). The model bunds only the cells at or below spring high water.
